issues.description: Multiple hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'setIsMounted is not defined'. The greeting 'Good evening, Amelia.' is time-dependent and renders differently on server vs client. Also setIsMounted state setter is referenced but not declared.
issues.element: Dashboard greeting text and isMounted state
issues.root_cause: The dashboard page likely computes a time-based greeting ('Good evening/morning/afternoon') during server render, but the client renders at a different time or with different logic. Additionally, setIsMounted is called but the useState hook for it is missing or the variable is out of scope.

issues.description: 'setIsMounted is not defined' repeated 14 times in console errors, indicating a ReferenceError that causes hydration failure and fallback to full client rendering.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx, setIsMounted is called (likely in a useEffect) but the corresponding useState declaration `const [isMounted, setIsMounted] = useState(false)` is missing.

issues.description: Dining Room card tag is truncated as 'NATU...' indicating the card width is too narrow to show all tags, but this may be intentional due to the carousel/scroll layout.
issues.root_cause: CSS overflow/truncation on the third card which is partially cut off by the viewport — likely intentional to hint scrollability.

fixes.reason: Verify this line exists — if missing, this is the fix needed
Return a static default greeting during SSR to prevent server/client HTML mismatch hydration error
Add the missing useState declaration for isMounted so setIsMounted is defined, fixing the ReferenceError and hydration crash
